samples: Wohan ninyai hom, Anisong tan ha phakan, Wohan lokanainya

lede: Wat Ban Luk accounts for 270 catalogued manuscripts, 11 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Lampang (99% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Tha District. Nearly all (97%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (94%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (5%). Dated witnesses run 1563–1958 CE (195 of 270 carry a date).
